fact_summary: Circle disclosed about $3.3 billion of USDC reserves at Silicon Valley Bank after SVB entered FDIC receivership on 2023-03-10 (Reuters: $3.3B of $40B; Chainalysis roughly 8%). Secondary USDC traded near $0.87-$0.88 on 11 March 2023 (Chainalysis about $0.87 by 02:00; CoinDesk Kraken USDC/USDT as low as 87 cents at 07:16 UTC). Circle said it would stand behind 1:1 redemption and cover any shortfall with corporate resources if needed; the peg was not restored that day.
why_it_matters: First major USDC secondary depeg tied to a traditional-bank receivership of reserve deposits.

fact_summary: A joint Treasury, Federal Reserve, and FDIC statement at 18:15 ET Sunday 12 March 2023 announced a systemic-risk exception that would make SVB depositors whole on Monday. Circle expected to recover the $3.3 billion and to resume liquidity operations Monday 13 March. The Fed FEDS Note records a sharp secondary recovery after the announcement and full recovery once Circle processed redemptions on Monday 13 March.
why_it_matters: Official deposit backstop, not an issuer capital raise, coincided with peg recovery.

fact_summary: From 1 July 2024 Circle SAS became a dual issuer of USDC, fully fungible with USDC issued by Circle LLC. USDC is an e-money token under MiCA; the white paper was notified to France's ACPR on 31 May 2024, and Circle obtained an EMI license from ACPR. The 72-hour USDC secondary peg path for 1-3 July 2024 is [UNKNOWN] on the sourced pages.
why_it_matters: USDC obtained an EU e-money issuance path that later venue restrictions treated as MiCA-compliant.

fact_summary: Coinbase Europe Limited and Coinbase Germany GmbH restrict USDT, PAX, PYUSD, GUSD, GYEN, and DAI at 11:59 CET on 13 December 2024. USDC and EURC remain supported; Coinbase said it may re-enable services if tokens later meet MiCA. The 72-hour USDT peg path for 13-15 December 2024 is [UNKNOWN] on the sourced pages.
why_it_matters: A major EEA venue restricted USDT trading/receiving while keeping USDC/EURC.

fact_summary: On 31 January 2025 Tether released a BDO assurance opinion for Q4 2024 as of 31 December 2024. The page states group assets $157.6B, liabilities $137.6B, token reserves $143,704,755,547, issuer token liabilities $136,617,485,006, excess $7,087,270,541, Treasuries direct plus indirect $113B, and 2024 profit exceeding $13B. Proprietary investments are not counted in token reserves; the 72-hour USDT peg path is [UNKNOWN].
why_it_matters: Point-in-time BDO assurance with a first-time excess buffer above $7B as stated by Tether.

fact_summary: Circle Internet Group priced an IPO on 4 June 2025 of 34,000,000 Class A shares at $31.00. Shares were expected to begin trading on the NYSE on 5 June 2025 under ticker CRCL; closing expected 6 June 2025. This is an issuer-operational listing, not a peg failure; the 72-hour USDC peg path is [UNKNOWN].
why_it_matters: USDC's issuer listed Class A shares; event is corporate listing, not a peg print.

fact_summary: The GENIUS Act (S.1582) was signed on 18 July 2025 and became Public Law 119-27. Congress.gov records Senate passage 68-30 and House passage 308-122. The 72-hour USDT/USDC peg path around 18-20 July 2025 is [UNKNOWN].
why_it_matters: Federal statute creating a US payment-stablecoin framework covering USD stablecoins including USDT and USDC as a class.

fact_summary: Tether's Q2 2025 BDO attestation is as of 30 June 2025. The tether.io news page states YTD USDT issuance $20B, Treasuries exceeding $127B, Q2 net profit approximately $4.9B, and H1 $5.7B. Proprietary investments are not in token reserves; the 72-hour peg path is [UNKNOWN].
why_it_matters: Quarterly FFRR snapshot with Treasury exposure and excess-capital language from the issuer page.

fact_summary: The MiCA CASP 18-month transition ends on 1 July 2026. Circle USDC/EURC are ACPR-authorized e-money tokens; Tether did not seek EMT authorization, with Ardoino citing a 60% EU bank-deposit reserve rule. Do not claim a global USDT supply crash; sourced reporting is little global demand shift; the 72-hour peg path is [UNKNOWN].
why_it_matters: Hard outer CASP transition date; USDT lacks EMT authorization on sourced pages; no sourced global supply crash.

fact_summary: On 13 August 2026 Tether announced a KPMG U.S. unqualified opinion on Tether International financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025. Tether said reserves exceeded liabilities by $6.814 billion as of 31 December 2025. CoinDesk reported the full KPMG report was not published; the 72-hour peg path is [UNKNOWN].
why_it_matters: First full financial-statement audit opinion as described by Tether; excess figure is as-of 31 Dec 2025, not a 2026 quarterly print.
